message.reasoning: The user asks: "在18世紀期間，法國的國王是誰？" They want the monarchs of France during the 18th century. We have a function european_history_get_monarchs that can provide a list of monarchs based on country and century. So we should call that function with country="France", century=18. The function returns a list of monarchs. Then we need to respond with the answer. The user didn't specify a particular year or range, just "during the 18th century". So we should provide all monarchs who reigned at any point in the 1700s. That would include Louis XV (1715-1774), Louis XVI (1774-1792). Also maybe Louis XVIII (1814-1815, 1815-1824) but that's 19th century. So only those two. But also maybe mention that the monarchy was abolished after 1792. So we should provide the list.
